name: Purple Sector Live Timing
description:
Live motorsport session results in the top bar: practice, qualifying, sprint and race.

* Panel icon, optionally with the top 1–3 drivers and their gaps
* Click for the full classification with team colours, Q1/Q2/Q3 sections and an expandable table (tyres, last and best laps, pit stops)
* Connects automatically shortly before each session, offline otherwise
* Notifications for session start, new leader, Safety Car / red flag and the finish
* Optional delay to stay in sync with the TV broadcast
* Built-in demo race with fictional drivers

Unofficial. Uses the public live timing feed and the Jolpica calendar API.
